title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Spyglass has successfully transitioned from beta to general availability, empowering you with enhanced insights and improved functionality.

title: Enhanced File and Image Management
summary: Gain comprehensive control over your embedded files and images directly within the editor, with new options to easily manage, upload, and customize their appearance.

title: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap
summary: Experience full transparency with our brand-new public roadmap, showcasing recently completed updates, what's coming next, and our exciting plans for the future.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: Experience enhanced productivity with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, more visually integrated, and fully draggable.

title: Elevated Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly enhanced your real-time collaboration experience, making it more intuitive and seamless for teams to work together.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Sharing
summary: We've made it easier than ever to discover and collaborate on your ideas and quests with friends, ensuring shared items are always at your fingertips.

title: Unlock Global Languages
summary: We are thrilled to introduce comprehensive support for international languages, making Noeko accessible to users worldwide.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: We are opening Noeko's codebase to empower our community with greater control and direct involvement, fostering transparency and collaborative growth.

title: Powerful Constellation View Enhancements
summary: Transform your Constellation view into an intelligent hub for discovery and organization with advanced filtering by tags, time, and shared content.

title: Intelligent Search Filters and Personalized Collections
summary: Effortlessly refine your knowledge with powerful filtering and sorting options, then save your unique search criteria as personalized collections for quick future reference.

title: Interactive Content Previews
summary: Unlock a new level of note organization with interactive content previews, making your linked information more accessible and dynamic than ever before.

title: Noeko: Your Way – Self-Hosting and Premium Features
summary: Empower your organization with the flexibility to host Noeko on your own infrastructure or unlock advanced capabilities and resources through our new premium plans.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Fresh Themes
summary: Transform your workspace with an array of beautiful new themes and expertly refined classic designs, making every interaction more visually appealing and enjoyable.

title: Accurate Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your personalized welcome message on the homepage always reflects the precise time of day, enhancing your daily experience.

title: Enhanced Tag Management Actions
summary: Effortlessly organize your content by quickly unapplying tags and performing other essential actions directly from any tag view, boosting your productivity.

title: Unlock a World of Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate and interact with a diverse array of content, from YouTube videos to websites and text files, to centralize and enhance your information diet.
